purpose: single diagnostic binary OFF/ON ABBA; cumulative capture admission/archive/classification elapsed time and observer self-cost, no optimization claim
binary_strategy: one fresh Actions release API build from exact diagnostic product; same file/hash for OFF1/ON1/ON2/OFF2; previous baseline/candidate API binaries forbidden

sampling.root_identity: owned root PID/start ticks pinned before snapshots
sampling.CPU_average: 100%=one core; seconds/request plus exact window/peak interval
sampling.incomplete_identity: null and separately labelled captured lower bound; no missing-to-zero conversion
sampling.PG_PSS_IO: ordinary permission denial=>null, no alternate identity/tool

protocol_fixture.history_boundary: synthetic fixture only; not all requests or any product cap

requests.scope_excludes: owned fixture bootstrap/setup/cleanup HTTP; all synthetic

diagnostics.selection: boot environment latched once at first capture; new API process per fixture
diagnostics.units: cumulative monotonic elapsed ns; count/total/max/failures/cancelled; never CPU
diagnostics.overlap: classifier includes nested fact DB awaits; worker includes collect/replay/classifier/facts; admission/complete wait occur concurrently with worker; do not add stages or call sum CPU
diagnostics.admission_boundary: starts after original frame copy/timestamp; measures send.await scheduling/admission, not durable DB ACK or isolated queue wait
diagnostics.complete_boundary: finish through wait_finished/result; emit after timer; first complete_end log not exact socket/body EOF
diagnostics.logging: at most worker_end and first complete_end per capture; no per-frame log or retained payload; stage snapshots not jointly atomic; normal body Drop repeats complete, so later complete-wait calls are not all included in first complete_end
diagnostics.collector: attached only to owned synthetic API pipes; retain fixed whitelist diagnostic lines, discard unrelated text; export exactly measured flow UUIDs/capture IDs after whole:end
diagnostics.limits: diagnostic safety bounds, not product business caps

existing_timing_query.scope: current qadb/current app/exact8 measured UUIDs per fixture
existing_timing_query.fields: attempt timestamp + existing host timing summary/receipt whitelist only
existing_timing_query.missing: null/unavailable and diagnostic gate fails; no fabricated EOF/recorder/dispatcher span

functional_gates.requirements: all exact test names/nonzero counts/failure zero; slow writer backpressure and complete barrier, raw bytes/cursors/prebind/drop/partial-failure semantics; OFF and ON same source with no source/SQL/queue/watermark/projection delta
functional_gates.full_protocol_merge_gate: not replaced by this diagnostic; no PR/merge/deploy

test_only_overlay.scope: only cfg(test) zero-delay immediate MemoryWriter archive notification before next admission;20ms burst unchanged; original comparative/byte/sequence assertions retained
test_only_overlay.restore: success and failure EXIT; original SHA and clean tracked product source mandatory before release build

acceptance.primary: locate elapsed admission/worker/fact/complete wait only after same-binary self-cost controls
acceptance.observer_cost: show CPU/request, driver CPU, TTFT/total/first-last/terminal-EOF, logs/clock reads/bytes per mode and individual ABBA fixtures; N16/mode only two fixture clusters, no precise overhead bound or production gain inferred
acceptance.interpretation: same provider/driver/SQL sampler in both modes; stage dominance may localize owner but does not prove DB/lock/scheduler CPU causality or make stages mutually exclusive
acceptance.suspicion: large or inconsistent ON/OFF CPU/latency shift means instrumented timings perturb workload/inconclusive, not optimization or automatic new run
acceptance.next_candidate: only after measured waits and self-cost, propose one semantic-preserving scheduling change; do not enlarge queue, remove await, batch Step+sections, or add concurrency now

previous_failed_gate.outcome: control-plane OFF37pass/1old burst comparator fail1->1;12new tests allpass; ON/API/build/resource not executed
previous_failed_gate.fix: historical exact-source fixture synchronization, not product or permission change; no blind retry
